caption: Figure 45-1
Dark, top, and Light, bottom, each with two accents.

blocks.p: There are three base themes: *Dark*, *Light* and *High contrast*. The theme sets the colors of every ZNIX window. The accent color marks what is chosen or switched on, such as the open tab.

marks.text: The accent color marks the open tab and the buttons that are on.

sticky.text: Three base themes and an accent color.

blocks.p: The theme and the accent are chosen in three places: from the window menu, from *ZeD setup*, and on a controller from the ZeD wheel. In *ZeD setup*, *Character window accent* and *World window accent* give each window an accent of its own.

caption: Figure 45-2

blocks.note: Every ZeD window has the box.

marks.text: The title bar's right-hand box opens the window menu: Theme, Accent and more.

sticky.text: Click the window box for the window menu.
